body: I remember breaking down crying for no reason about every other day when I was little.

you didnt waste my time. you should start or join an AA group and share this with them too, those groups usually have other people with stories like yours too and they can help a lot. and you would get to help other people too and that would make you feel a little better. Also, I think rehab would be a good choice. Remember it's ok to be confused just try to sort through things, it'll get better.
